articles.summary: WYOMISSING, Pa., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. (NASDAQ: GLPI) (“GLPI” or the “Company”), announced today that on August 31, the Company’s Board of Directors declared the third quarter 2026 cash dividend of $0.82 per share of its common stock.
articles.title: Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. Declares Third Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend of $0.82 Per Share
